summary: native-frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The npm package presents itself as a CircleCI orb (YAML CI configuration under src/jobs/, src/@orb.yml,.circleci/config.yml) but ships a Node preinstall hook that does not match that purpose. package.json declares "preinstall": "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs probes for a local bun binary; if absent, it downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it as execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js]). The sibling math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle produced by an obfuscator.io-style transform (rotating string-array WV8StW, decoder hc1jfK9, all identifiers renamed to _0x-style random names), so its content is not inspectable by Node-scoped tooling. Executing the bundle via a freshly fetched alternate runtime evades scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. The package name is also inconsistent with the declared repository (ornikar/orb-frontend-native with a swapped word order), consistent with a lookalike publication of a legitimate CircleCI orb. Installing this package causes an opaque, obfuscated payload to execute on the installer's host at npm install time under a runtime the package fetches itself; a CircleCI orb has no legitimate need for any of this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
